notes.title: 9 29 24 Patch
notes.notes:
1) A chest in the Lockfried Ruins wasn't opening, fixed
2) Dialogue/Menu glitch that could happen at the TV station fixed
3) Preacher running glitch fixed
4) Kubo ruins second elevator glitch fixed
5) Museum Girl would give reward after 1 item was found, this was fixed. It is now
    required that you collect and hand in all the artifacts before receiving the reward.
6) Music volume reduced for final mission briefing
7) Kubo Refractor respawn glitch fixed (I believe)
8) Glitch created in previous patch where if knocked down, sometimes the blinking 
    of Teflon's armor to indicate iframes wouldn't stop was fixed.

notes.title: Fixed Softlock Previous Patch Created
notes.notes:
So I made it so Vela turns to talk to you in the last patch. Turned out this broke multiple cutscenes. Terribly sorry to everyone who was hit by this.

It's fixed now.
